phrases.speak: A tiny server just counted the lines in a real file. That is MCP at work.
phrases.show: A tiny server just counted the lines in a real file. That is MCP at work.

phrases.speak: Without MCP, every AI app needs custom code for every tool, file, and database it touches.
phrases.show: Without MCP, every AI app needs custom code for every tool, file, and database it touches.

phrases.speak: Four apps and four tools mean sixteen custom integrations.
phrases.show: Four apps and four tools mean sixteen custom integrations.

phrases.speak: MCP, the Model Context Protocol, is an open standard that fixes that.
phrases.show: MCP, the Model Context Protocol, is an open standard that fixes that.

phrases.speak: Your AI app is the host, and it runs one client for each server it connects to.
phrases.show: Your AI app is the host, and it runs one client for each server it connects to.

phrases.speak: A server offers three things: tools the model can call, resources it can read, and prompts you can reuse.
phrases.show: A server offers three things: tools the model can call, resources it can read, and prompts you can reuse.

phrases.speak: Messages are JSON-RPC, sent over standard input and output locally, or over HTTP for remote servers.
phrases.show: Messages are JSON-RPC, sent over standard input and output locally, or over HTTP for remote servers.

phrases.speak: Let's watch it happen with a real server. It is twenty-four lines, built with the official TypeScript SDK.
phrases.show: Let's watch it happen with a real server. It is twenty-four lines, built with the official TypeScript SDK.

phrases.speak: The client starts by asking who the server is and what it supports.
phrases.show: The client starts by asking who the server is and what it supports.

phrases.speak: Then it asks for the tools. The server lists one: count lines.
phrases.show: Then it asks for the tools. The server lists one: count lines.

phrases.speak: Now the call. Count the lines in notes dot text. The server reads the file, and answers: eleven lines.
phrases.show: Now the call. Count the lines in notes.txt. The server reads the file, and answers: eleven lines.

phrases.speak: That same pattern works for any MCP server.
phrases.show: That same pattern works for any MCP server.

phrases.speak: To use it in Claude Code, add it with one command.
phrases.show: To use it in Claude Code, add it with one command.

phrases.speak: Claude Code checks the connection: connected.
phrases.show: Claude Code checks the connection: connected.

phrases.speak: MCP is the standard plug between AI apps and your tools.
phrases.show: MCP is the standard plug between AI apps and your tools.
